{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the six internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute the number of converted and total orders
converted_count = df_new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(df_new_paid_search)
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

# Print the numbers that will be used in evidence
print(converted_count)
print(total_count)
print(fraction_converted)"}
